evidence.finding: Input generation occurs before timing; the timer encloses qtClustering and the final world barrier.
Only size and ownership metadata precede MPI_Comm_split_type; its pinned internal world allreduce gates subsequent useful clustering work on rank 0's timed entry.
Coordinates are copied into a device layout and empty workspaces are initialized inside the timed call; no distances or computed candidates are prepared here.
The device distance function computes Euclidean distances directly from coordinates.
Candidate growth evaluates pairwise distances on demand and incrementally updates maximum distances.
Stale-list construction, candidate/cache computation, blocking result copies, joined OpenMP reduction and global winner selection occur inside the timed call.
Winning-cluster regeneration completes through a blocking device-to-host copy before broadcast; subsequent membership updates remain inside timing.
Legacy device allocations are freed before function return, completing outstanding GPU work before arrival at the final barrier.
The elapsed duration is converted to milliseconds and printed only by rank 0 using %ld.
